name: ReposiTrak, Inc.
business_overview: ReposiTrak, Inc., a software-as-a-service provider, operates a business-to-business, e-commerce, compliance and traceability, and supply chain management platform in North America. It offers ReposiTrak Compliance Management, which reduces potential regulatory, legal, and criminal risks from its supply chain partners; ReposiTrak Traceability Network, which captures key data elements for designated products; and ReposiTrak Supply Chain Solutions, which enable customers to manage interactions with suppliers. The company also provides business consulting services to suppliers and retailers in the grocery, convenience, and specialty retail sectors. In addition, it provides professional consulting services. The company primarily serves multi-store retail chains, wholesalers, distributors, and their suppliers. ReposiTrak, Inc. has a strategic partnership with Upshop to enable grocery retail traceability. The company was formerly known as Park City Group, Inc. and changed its name to ReposiTrak, Inc. in December 2023. ReposiTrak, Inc. is based in Murray, Utah.

classification_meta.logic_summary: SaaS platform for supply chain compliance, traceability, and e-commerce for grocery and retail sectors.

The company has also completed development of a new monitoring device, suggesting product-line renewal that could support future contract wins. No explicit demand softness or competitive pressures appear in the commentary, and management expects continued full-year revenue expansion and underlying profit improvement, signaling a stable and gradually improving demand environment.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership executed a transformative recapitalization that markedly deleveraged the balance sheet, extended debt maturities, and raised fresh equity — decisively resetting the capital structure. The heavily discounted settlement of legacy obligations and the new credit facility reveal disciplined negotiation and a focus on financial flexibility. By concurrently delivering operational improvements and right-sizing the cost base, management is aligning the company for long-term value creation, and its expressed confidence in sustained growth, excluding one-time charges, suggests a more credible, execution-oriented posture.
